text:
Nora: Quick sync 1 — several managers report calendar conflicts with the signoff window due to customer travel. We need a contingency plan by EOD.
PeopleOpsBot: Signoff window status: 9 managers pending, 3 flagged as traveling.
Diego: I can take 2 signoffs tomorrow morning. Which ones are flagged as travel?
Nora: I'll DM the list. Prefer we keep deadline but allow delegation. We should define how delegated reviews appear in the export so calibration isn't confused.
Sam: For delegation, add a "delegated_by" column and mark reviewer_role=delegate in the form export. PeopleOps can reconcile before calibration.
Alex: Also recommend a tiny checklist for delegates: confirm form assignment, review last 6 months of goals, keep examples concise, add "delegated" prefix in notes.
Nora: Good. Also, if more than 8 delegations requested, we'll push signoff 48h. If fewer, we'll assign backups manually. Can managers reply with "out:dates" so we can count quickly?
Diego: out: Thu-Fri. I'll cover one of my peers.
Sam: out: Thu. Delegating to Priya (she's aware).
Nora: Tally so far: 2 out. PeopleOpsBot will send a reminder ping in 90 minutes for outstanding signoffs.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 90 minutes.
Alex: If we end up extending, please log it in the release calendar so calibration leads see the change.
Nora: Will do. Final ask: delegates, once assigned, update the form by EOD and tag @people-ops so we can update the calibration export.
Diego: Confirmed for the reviews I picked up.
Nora: Thanks all 1 I'll post final decision by 3pm PT.
